newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour says may privatise air traffic control.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour says may privatise air traffic control.

text.p: The poor state of Britain's public finances means the opposition Labour Party may have to consider privatising air traffic control to raise funds, finance spokesman Alistair Darling said on Thursday.

"So far as air traffic control is concerned it became clear in the early part of this year the government was actually relying on this capital receipt not this year as they first claimed but actually in the next financial year," he told BBC radio.

"Now that means that we have to look at that. We are inheriting a situation that is not of our own making. It would be grossly irresponsible is for any politcal party to campaign on the basis that there wasn't a problem with the public finances and therefore they could promise the earth," he said.
Darling denied that there had been any change to Labour's stance on privatisation.
Labour is comfortably ahead in opinion polls and is widely expected to win the May 1 general election.
